0: BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and the Council of the Town of Pine Mountain, Harris County, in duty assembled, is hereby ordained by the authority of same that the following ordinance known as the Wellhead Protection Ordinance is adopted and made a part of the Code of Ordinances of the Town of Pine Mountain, to wit:
1:
- (a) This ordinance shall be known as the “Wellhead Protection Ordinance.”

- (b) The purpose of this ordinance is to insure the provision of a safe and sanitary drinking water supply for the Town of Pine Mountain by the establishment of wellhead protection zones surrounding the wellheads for all wells and Springs which are the supply sources for the Town of Pine Mountain water system, and by designation and regulation of property uses and conditions which may be maintained within such zones.
2: There is hereby established a use district to be known as a wellhead protection zone as identified and described within the attached State of Georgia approved wellhead protection plan.
3: Land use and activities in the wellhead protection zones as identified and described as potential pollution sources in the attached State of Georgia approved wellhead protection plan will be prohibited as stated in the plan.
4:
The policies and procedures for administration of any wellhead protection zone established under this ordinance, shall be the same as provided in the existing zoning ordinance for the Town of Pine Mountain, as the same is presently enacted or may from time to time be amended.

This ordinance shall be effective as of February 9, 2009. All ordinances and parts of ordinance in conflict herewith shall be hereby repealed.

ENACTED AND ADOPTED THIS 9th Day of February, 2009.
